purpose: Freeze the dataset-specific synthetic qualification that a fresh phylogatR Phase-2 survivor geometry must pass before nucleotide identities may be unmasked. This reuses the already-frozen genetic Gate-D method family without adapting it to the Decker development qualification result or to fresh empirical outcomes.

development_result_is_not_a_tuning_input.rule: No parameter below may be changed because the Decker A3 private-null Wilson upper bound narrowly exceeded its frozen ceiling. Fresh geometry receives an independent qualification under the same method family.

seed_contract.master_seed_rule: payload = UTF8('ttf|phylogatr|phase3|' + phase2.dataset_digest_sha256 + '|' + phase2.geometry_fingerprint_sha256); master_seed = int.from_bytes(SHA256(payload)[0:8], 'little')

execution_defaults.sharding_semantics: contiguous absolute replicate index ranges only; batch or shard boundaries cannot alter world identity or inference

pass_action: A PASS may authorize a separate explicit Phase-4 nucleotide-identity opening receipt for this exact fresh dataset and split. PASS is not itself an empirical biological result.
failure_action: STOP and record NOT_EVALUABLE. Do not open fresh nucleotide identities or pairwise genetic distances and do not alter the panel, graph, split, bandwidth, reference family, world counts, alpha, or Wilson thresholds to rescue the result.
forbidden_after_freeze: changing the 500 km bandwidth based on fresh geometry support or synthetic outcomes
changing private-reference configurations or selected-config count
changing mandatory cells, world counts, alpha, or Wilson thresholds
dropping low-support species or edges after Phase 2
using Decker empirical outcomes as a tuning signal
opening fresh nucleotide identity before a complete Phase-3 PASS receipt
